items.name: Pomegranate Fennel Sherbet
steps: Boil 700 ml (about 3 cups) water for 2 minutes, cool it completely, and reserve it for Pomegranate Fennel Sherbet so the finished drink needs no ice.

Stir crushed fennel and rock sugar into the juice with water. Stir for 30–45 seconds with the heat off, until the sweetener dissolves, then taste and keep the drink gently cool without ice.
Add sliced mint and serve the sherbet without ice. Stir for 10–15 seconds with the heat off, taste once, and serve gently cool without ice before the fresh herbs darken.
